## POST `/api/2.29/support-diagnostics`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a diagnostics task for a given time interval. If `start_time` is not provided, defaults to Current System Time - 1 hour. If `end_time` is not provided, defaults to Current System Time. If a task is already running, an error is returned.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `analysis_period_end_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the analysis time window ends (in milliseconds since epoch). |
| `analysis_period_start_time` | query | integer (int64) |  | When the analysis time window starts (in milliseconds since epoch). |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `SupportDiagnosticsGetResponse` · `403` Another instance is already running
